```{r verif, echo=FALSE}

verification_tbl <- subset(params[['userDataRMD']][['AA-1']][[1]], PARAMETER %in% c('SITE_ID','VISIT_NO', "ACTUAL_DATE","AA_LAT", "AA_LON", "HGM_CLASS"),
                       select = c('PARAMETER','RESULT'))

verification_tbl$PARAMETER[verification_tbl$PARAMETER=='SITE_ID'] <- 'Site ID'
verification_tbl$PARAMETER[verification_tbl$PARAMETER=='AA_LAT'] <- 'Latitude'
verification_tbl$PARAMETER[verification_tbl$PARAMETER=='AA_LON'] <- 'Longitude'
verification_tbl$PARAMETER[verification_tbl$PARAMETER=='VISIT_NO'] <- 'Visit Number'
verification_tbl$PARAMETER[verification_tbl$PARAMETER=='ACTUAL_DATE'] <- 'Sample Date'
verification_tbl$PARAMETER[verification_tbl$PARAMETER=='HGM_CLASS'] <- 'HGM Class'

pv1 <- subset(params[['userDataRMD']][['PV-1']][[1]], PARAMETER %in% c('SITESAMP', 'VALXSITE'),
                       select = c('PARAMETER','RESULT'))
verification_tbl <- rbind(verification_tbl, subset(pv1, PARAMETER=='VALXSITE'))
verification_tbl$PARAMETER[verification_tbl$PARAMETER=='VALXSITE'] <- 'Wetland Type'

sampled <- subset(pv1, PARAMETER=='SITESAMP')$RESULT

```



```{r palt,echo=F}
## Physical Alteration - just list over all types observed in any plot
if(sampled=='Y' & !is.null(params[['userDataRMD']][['P-1']])){
  p1 <- subset(params[['userDataRMD']][['P-1']][[1]], str_detect(PARAMETER, 'WADSUB|WOBSTR|VEGREM|VEGREP|SOILHD|SOILMD') & str_detect(PARAMETER, 'NONE_PRESENT')==FALSE & !is.null(RESULT) & RESULT!='',
               select = c('PARAMETER')) 
  
  if(sampled=='Y' & nrow(p1)>0){
    p1$PATYPE <- with(p1, substring(PARAMETER, 1, 6)) 
    
  }
}

if(sampled=='Y' & !is.null(params[['userDataRMD']][['P-2']])){
  p2 <- subset(params[['userDataRMD']][['P-2']][[1]], str_detect(PARAMETER, 'WADSUB|WOBSTR|VEGREM|VEGREP|SOILHD|SOILMD') & str_detect(PARAMETER, 'NONE_PRESENT')==FALSE & !is.null(RESULT) & RESULT!='',
               select = c('PARAMETER')) 
  
  if(sampled=='Y' & nrow(p2)>0){
    p2$PATYPE <- with(p2, substring(PARAMETER, 1, 6))
    if(exists('p1') & nrow(p1)>0){
      p.all <- rbind(p1, p2)
      puniq <- unique(p.all)
    }
  }else if(sampled=='Y' & nrow(p1)>0){
    puniq <- unique(p1)

  }
  if(exists('puniq')){
    palt_tbl <- puniq %>%
      left_join(PhysAltLabels, by = c("PARAMETER")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ALIAS)) %>%
      select(`Physical Alteration(s) Observed`=ALIAS)
      
    
  } else{
    palt_tbl <- data.frame(PATYPE=c("None Observed"),
                           stringsAsFactors=F)
  }

}


```

```{r v2, echo=FALSE}
## Plant species observed
if(sampled=='Y' & !is.null(params[['userDataRMD']][['V-2']])){
  spp <- subset(params[['userDataRMD']][['V-2']][[1]], select = c('PLOT', 'SPECIES', 'COVER')) %>% filter(!(str_detect(SPECIES, "DELETE|DISREGARD")))
  
  if(sampled=='Y' & nrow(spp)>0){
    spp_tbl <- spp %>%
      filter(!is.na(SPECIES)) %>%
      group_by(SPECIES) %>%
      summarize(`% Cover¹` = sum(as.numeric(COVER) / n_distinct(PLOT))) %>%
      arrange(desc(`% Cover¹`)) %>%
      rename(`Taxa Name`=SPECIES)
    
    # spp <- subset(spp2, !is.na(SPECIES))
    # spp_tbl <- unique(spp)
    # spp_tbl <- spp_tbl[order(spp_tbl$SPECIES),]
  }
}
```

```{r soil profile, echo=FALSE}
if(sampled=='Y' & !is.null(params[['userDataRMD']][['S-1']])){
  soil_tbl <- subset(params[['userDataRMD']][['S-1']][[1]], PARAMETER %in% c('DEPTH','PIT_DEPTH','SM_HUE','SM_VALUE','SM_CHROMA','HORIZON_NAME', 'SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH'),
                 select = c('HORIZON', 'PARAMETER','RESULT'))
}
```


```{r water, echo=FALSE}
if(sampled=='Y' & !is.null(params[['userDataRMD']][['W-1']])){
  # Pull DO, cond, pH, and temp of water
  field_tbl <- subset(params[['userDataRMD']][['W-1']][[1]], PARAMETER %in% c('SW_COVERAGE', 'SW_DEPTH_MAX', 'WATER_TYPE'),
                 select = c('PARAMETER','RESULT'))
  
  field_tbl$group <- field_tbl$PARAMETER
  
  field_tbl$RESULT[field_tbl$PARAMETER == 'SW_COVERAGE'] <- paste(field_tbl$RESULT[field_tbl$PARAMETER == 'SW_COVERAGE'], '%', sep = ' ')
  field_tbl$RESULT[field_tbl$PARAMETER == 'SW_DEPTH_MAX'] <- paste(field_tbl$RESULT[field_tbl$PARAMETER == 'SW_DEPTH_MAX'], 'cm', sep = ' ')
  
  field_tbl$group[field_tbl$group == 'SW_COVERAGE'] <- 1
  field_tbl$group[field_tbl$group == 'SW_DEPTH_MAX'] <- 2
  field_tbl$group[field_tbl$group == 'WATER_TYPE'] <- 3
  
  field_tbl$PARAMETER[field_tbl$PARAMETER=='SW_COVERAGE'] <- 'Surface Water Coverage Across AA' 
  field_tbl$PARAMETER[field_tbl$PARAMETER=='SW_DEPTH_MAX'] <- 'Maximum Surface Water Depth'
  field_tbl$PARAMETER[field_tbl$PARAMETER=='WATER_TYPE'] <- 'Predominant Water Feature'

  field_tbl <- field_tbl[order(field_tbl$group),]
  field_tbl <- subset(field_tbl, select = -group)
  
  field_tbl <- field_tbl %>%
    left_join(WaterFeatureLabels, by = c("RESULT"="PARAMETER")) %>%
    mutate(RESULT=ifelse(PARAMETER=="Predominant Water Feature", ALIAS, RESULT)) %>%
    select(-ALIAS)
  
} 
```

}

```{r soilprof, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.cap='The soil profile plot shows the soil profile and provides a true representation of hue, value and chroma measured in the field and displayed in each horizon block. The surface and top of profile is the 0cm mark and is represented by the gray dotted line. Water level at time of sampling (when applicable) is represented by the blue dotted line and was measured during soil pit excavation. Letter designations in the profile represent soil horizon and layer designations when known by the field scientist (see this [link](https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/resources/education-and-teaching-materials/a-soil-profile) and this [link](https://www.soils4teachers.org/soilhorizons) for more information on soil profiles and naming conventions).'}

if(is.null(params[['userDataRMD']][['S-1']])){
  cat("Soil data not available for this site.\n")
} else if (!"DEPTH" %in% soil_tbl$PARAMETER) {
  # Column missing or all values are NA
  cat("Soil profile data not available for this site.\n")
} else {

SPC_object <- soil_tbl %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = PARAMETER,
              values_from = RESULT) %>%
  # Donny: The commented out fill was throwing an error when SURFACE_wATER_DEPTH wasn't found.
  # Donny: The fix below sets SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH to NA if it is missing.
  {
    if (!"SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH" %in% names(.)) {
      .$SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH <- NA
    }
    fill(., SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH)
  } %>%
  #fill(SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH) %>%
  filter(!(HORIZON=="0")) %>%
  mutate(across(c("DEPTH", "SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH", "PIT_DEPTH"), as.numeric),
         SITE_ID = verification_tbl$RESULT[[2]],
         Top_Depth = coalesce(lag(DEPTH), 0),
         Bottom_Depth = DEPTH,
         height = Bottom_Depth - Top_Depth,
         soil_color = munsell2rgb(SM_HUE, SM_VALUE, SM_CHROMA)
  ) 
#glimpse(SPC_object)

depths(SPC_object) <- SITE_ID ~ Top_Depth + Bottom_Depth


plotSPC(
  SPC_object,
  name = 'HORIZON_NAME',
  id.style = 'none',
  max.depth = 125,
  cex.names = 1,
  cex.axis = 1,
  name.style = 'center-center',
  depth.axis = TRUE,
  hz.depths = TRUE,
  fixLabelCollisions = TRUE,
  hz.depths.offset = 0,
  # color = 'soil_color'  # uncomment if your plotSPC doesn't auto-use soil_color
  y.offset = 0
)

# Add title after the plot so it shows up
title('Soil Profile', line = 1, cex.main = 1.1)

#addVolumeFraction(SPC_object, colname = 'frag_pct')

# If SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH is a single site-level value per profile,
# abline with a vector will draw multiple horizontal lines across the panel(s).
#water_table_depth <- unique(SPC_object$SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH)
#abline(h = water_table_depth, col = "lightblue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
#abline(h = 0, col = "darkgray", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

# Donny: Added this code to deal with missing SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH issue.
water_table_depth <- unique(SPC_object$SURFACE_WATER_DEPTH)
water_table_depth <- water_table_depth[!is.na(water_table_depth)]

if (length(water_table_depth) > 0) {
  abline(h = water_table_depth, col = "lightblue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
}
abline(h = 0, col = "darkgray", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

}

```
